embeds.title: 🛸 AREA 51 — Community Rules
embeds.description: Welcome to Area 51! A community for everyone to chill, connect, make friends and enjoy gaming together.

fields.name: 1. Respect Everyone
fields.value:
• Treat every member with respect.
• No harassment, bullying, personal attacks or unnecessary arguments.
• Respect everyone's opinions and boundaries.

fields.name: 2. Be Friendly
fields.value:
• Keep the community welcoming and comfortable.
• Don't bother, annoy or intentionally disturb others.
• Avoid unnecessary drama and toxicity.

fields.name: 3. Gaming Freedom
fields.value:
• Play whatever game you enjoy.
• All games and gaming communities are welcome.
• Don't judge anyone for the game they play.

fields.name: 4. No Hate or Discrimination
fields.value:
• No racism, religious hatred, caste-based insults or discrimination.
• Don't target anyone for their background, language or identity.

fields.name: 5. Keep Chats Clean
fields.value:
• No spam, message flooding or excessive tagging.
• No unwanted advertisements or suspicious links.
• Use the appropriate channels.

fields.name: 6. Respect Privacy
fields.value:
• Never share personal information without permission.
• No recording, screenshots or sharing private conversations to embarrass others.

fields.name: 7. No Unnecessary Drama
fields.value:
• Don't start fights or bring personal conflicts here.
• If there's an issue, contact the staff team instead of escalating.

fields.name: 8. Follow Staff Instructions
fields.value:
• Respect moderators and administrators.
• Don't argue with staff decisions in public channels.
• If you disagree, discuss it respectfully.

fields.name: 9. No NSFW or Inappropriate Content
fields.value:
• Keep the community safe and comfortable for everyone.
• Don't share explicit or inappropriate content.

fields.name: 10. Enjoy Your Stay
fields.value:
• Make friends, play games, share moments and have fun.
• Be the reason someone enjoys being part of Area 51.

**Remember: Respect is mutual.** Treat others the way you expect to be treated.

Welcome to AREA 51. 👽
